en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formal square with geometric paving in front of a monumental stone terrace and steps. At the center is a landscaped area with shrubs; on the right is a ceremonial guard box in front of a long wall. Behind the terrace rises a grand neoclassical building. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk across the square. Printed captions in Greek and French appear along the bottom border.
